scheme_name: Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra.
Applicant must be a child or spouse of a registered construction worker.
The construction worker must be registered under the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW).
Applicant must be enrolled in a government‑recognized diploma or postgraduate diploma course.
Benefit applies to a maximum of two children and to the wife of registered male workers.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 per year for government‑recognized diploma courses and ₹25,000 per year for postgraduate diploma courses.
